incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: French Commercial Code (Code de commerce), Articles L.210-1 to L.210-10 (general commercial companies), L.223-1 to L.223-43 (SARL) and R.223-1 et seq.; Monetary and Financial Code (Code monétaire et financier), Articles L.532-9 et seq. (investment services and CIF regime); AMF General Regulation (Règlement général), Articles 312-1 et seq.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (RCS) kept by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce; incorporation formalities are filed electronically through the Guichet Unique operated by the Institut National de la Propriété Industrielle (INPI).
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Unified incorporation dossier 'M0' (Dossier unique d'immatriculation) filed via the INPI Guichet Unique portal, accompanied by the signed statuts (Articles of Association) and the mandatory declaration of beneficial owners (déclaration des bénéficiaires effectifs).
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum capital for the SARL (freely set above €1 under Article L.223-2 of the Commercial Code); however, the Multi-Family Office holding an AMF/ORIAS licence requires prudential minimum own funds of €125,000 (external AIFM) or €50,000 (MiFID discretionary portfolio management). The founders therefore subscribe and escrow €225,000 in a blocked French bank account (compte bloqué), released to the gérant only upon issuance of the RCS registration certificate (K-bis).
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: FIRST SHAREHOLDERS' RESOLUTION — [Name] SARL (in formation). Resolved unanimously: (1) The draft Articles of Association are approved in full. (2) The subscribed capital of €225,000, fully deposited in the blocked account at [Bank], is allocated among the founders in accordance with the subscription schedule. (3) The registered office is fixed at [Address], Paris, France. (4) [Name] is appointed Gérant for an indefinite term with full powers to bind the company and to open bank accounts. (5) The Gérant is authorized to publish the formation notice, to complete the Guichet Unique/RCS filing, and to seek the financial investment adviser registration with ORIAS and the AMF. (6) All preparatory acts are ratified.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Deposit of Subscribed Share Capital in a Blocked Account
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Licensed French credit institution or notaire public holding funds in escrow (Article L.223-7 of the Commercial Code).
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Open a temporary blocked account in the name of the company in formation with a French bank or a notary; each founder wires the subscribed sums from their own bank account; obtain the capital deposit certificate (attestation de dépôt de fonds or certificat du dépositaire) evidencing full payment of €225,000; the account is definitively released to the gérant only upon RCS registration. The certificate is mandatory for the incorporation file.
required_dossiers: Identity documents and proof of address of each shareholder
Source of funds declaration and bank statements
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries the source of wealth, provide supplementary tax returns, bank records and notarised wealth declarations; alternatively, place the capital with a notary escrow account (compte de dépôt notarié) and obtain the notarial capital certificate.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Articles of Association and Appointment of the Gérant
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: All shareholders (associés) acting unanimously, optionally assisted by a notaire public; deed signed under private seal (sous seing privé) or by notarial instrument.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene a constitutive shareholders' meeting; approve and sign the statuts containing corporate name, legal form, registered office, corporate object (discretionary portfolio advisory and multi-family office services), duration (99 years), share capital and division of quotas, governance powers of the gérant, and the limited liability clauses; record the gérant's formal acceptance of office; subscribe and initial each page of the share subscription schedule.
required_dossiers: Draft statuts approved by all shareholders
Power of attorney if a founder is represented
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a shareholder's identity or power of attorney is invalid, obtain notarised legalisation and apostille at the French consulate of origin, then re-execute the statuts and annex the corrected documents.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Publication of Legal Formation Notice (Avis de Constitution)
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: An approved legal announcement journal (Journal d'Annonces Légales — JAL) authorised by the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Draft and submit the avis de constitution stating the corporate name, legal form, capital amount, registered office address, corporate object, duration, and the name of the gérant; the JAL publishes the notice and issues the attestation de parution, which must be enclosed with the incorporation dossier.
required_dossiers: JAL order form and proof of publication fee payment
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the JAL suspends publication due to inconsistencies between the notice and the statuts, correct the discrepancies (name, address, capital or object) and resubmit within the statutory publication window.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Electronic Filing through the INPI Guichet Unique and RCS Registration
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Guichet Unique électronique (INPI) transmitting the dossier to the Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce for registration on the Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Log in to formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr and complete the unified M0 form; upload scanned statuts, capital deposit certificate, JAL attestation de parution, identity and residence proof of the gérant, and the declaration of beneficial owners; pay the filing fee electronically and sign the dossier; monitor the file; upon validation, collect the K-bis extract, SIREN/SIRET identifiers and the registration reference for subsequent licensing applications.
required_dossiers: Identity and residence proof of the gérant
Original power of attorney if the filing is made by a representative
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the registry issues a deficiency notice (lettre d'observations) within 8 working days, correct the file electronically through the secure repair protocol within 15 days; failure to cure causes the application to lapse and a new submission with renewed fees becomes necessary.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Post-Registration Ancillary Registrations and Operating Bank Account Opening
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: URSSAF, INSEE (Sirene), ACPR (Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution), Tracfin, and the chosen French credit institution.
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon issuance of the K-bis, activate the SIREN/SIRET identifiers; declare the gérant and any employees to URSSAF and the occupational health service; open an operating bank account presenting the completed corporate KYC and AML/CFT file of the MFO; file the initial information return with Tracfin for the high-risk portfolio advisory activity; prepare the compliance manual required under Articles L.533-10 and L.561-5 of the Monetary and Financial Code to accompany the ORIAS/AMF licence application.
required_dossiers: AML/CFT compliance manual and business continuity plan
Registered office lease or proof of domiciliation
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank refuses account opening, invoke the statutory right to an account (droit au compte) and apply to the Banque de France, which will designate a credit institution obliged to open the account on standard terms.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Autorité des Marchés Financiers (AMF) — Direction des Agréments, together with ORIAS (Organisme pour le registre unique des intermédiaires en assurance, banque et finance) for intermediary registration, and the ACPR for prudential supervision of the portfolio advisory activity.
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: Registration as a Financial Investment Adviser (Conseiller en Investissements Financiers — CIF) on the ORIAS register under AMF control, or, where discretionary management is exercised, the AMF authorisation as a portfolio management company (Agrément de société de gestion de portefeuille) under the MiFID/AIFM framework, supplemented by the AMF declaration of the compliance and internal control officer.

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Ministère de la Transition Écologique et de la Cohésion des Territoires — Direction Générale de la Prévention des Risques, with local prefecture oversight for ICPE matters and ADEME for waste and energy reporting.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — tertiary office activity outside the ICPE (Installations Classées pour la Protection de l'Environnement) authorisation and registration regime; no environmental impact assessment required; subject only to the RE2020 building energy regulation, the tertiary sector energy decree (décret tertiaire) and commercial waste segregation obligations.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No industrial discharges; office wastewater must comply with the local public sanitation network consent limits; waste must be sorted and recovered under Article L.541-21-2 of the Environmental Code; VOC emissions remain below the thresholds of Decree 2011-321; mandatory GHG reporting applies if annual emissions exceed 500 tCO2eq.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire safety certificate from the departmental fire commission for ERP Type W (Établissement Recevant du Public — offices), 5th category; structural load inspection certificate issued by an approved technical controller (contrôleur technique); occupational health clearance from the occupational health and safety service (SST) and CARSAT; accessibility compliance certification for persons with disabilities under the 2005 Handicap Act (Agenda d'Accessibilité Programmée).

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP), Ministère de l'Économie, des Finances et de la Souveraineté industrielle et numérique; local corporate-tax and VAT administration is handled by the Service des Impôts des Entreprises (SIE) of the registered office. Principal digital portals: https://www.impots.gouv.fr (professional EDI/EFI filing area), https://formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr (Guichet Unique for entity creation and registration), and https://portailfacturation.gouv.fr (Portail Public de Facturation, PPF). For the discretionary multi-family office (ISIC 6430), prior authorization from the Autorité des Marchés Financiers (AMF) and ACPR as a portfolio-management company (MiFID II, art. L. 532-9 CMF) or registration as a Conseiller en Investissements Financiers is a legal precondition to engaging in regulated activity, and the licence reference must be communicated to DGFiP.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Step 1: file the French SARL incorporation dossier with the Guichet Unique (formalites.entreprises.gouv.fr), including the statuts, non-resident director KYC (passport identity sheet, proof of address, certificate of non-bankruptcy), registered-office lease, and bank capital-blocking certificate. Step 2: INSEE allocates the 9-digit SIREN, SIRET and code APE 6630Z (gestion de fonds / multi-family office); the Guichet automatically transmits the file to DGFiP. Step 3: DGFiP issues the French VAT number (FR + 2-character control key + SIREN), verifiable on the EU VIES database, and opens the corporate income-tax file at the competent SIE; the first fiscal year-end and the statutory filing cycle (liasse fiscale n° 2065 plus annexes 2050-2067) are registered. Step 4: the AMF/ACPR authorisation, the AML/KYC compliance pack (banking_aml_risk_tier: High_Risk_Special_License), and the designation of a licensed depositary bank must be filed with the tax administration. No separate French domestic tax-registration certificate exists: the SIREN/SIRET and VAT number bundle constitutes the TIN for all DGFiP dealings.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: France has no full check-the-box regime but provides targeted elections: (i) CGI art. 239 bis AA allows an SME SARL (capital continuously held ≥ 75% by individuals or qualifying partnerships; fewer than 50 employees; turnover under €10m; unlisted) to elect income-tax passthrough (impôt sur le revenu) for five fiscal years; (ii) a single-member EURL owned by an individual is IR-transparent by default and may elect entity-level IS under CGI art. 206(1); (iii) a French parent holding ≥ 95% may elect tax consolidation (intégration fiscale, CGI art. 223-A); (iv) exempt financial services may be opted into VAT (CGI art. 260-B) to restore input-VAT recovery; and (v) EU ATAD hybrid-mismatch designation and documentation obligations apply to cross-border hybrid entities and instruments (BOI-IS-GPE-20-60-40, arts. 205 A CGI).

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: VAT — Taxe sur la Valeur Ajoutée (TVA), transposing EU Council Directive 2006/112/EC into CGI art. 256 et seq.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: There is no general registration threshold for established taxable persons: VAT registration is compulsory from the first taxable transaction unless the franchise en base de TVA applies. As from 1 March 2025 (Loi de finances 2025, CGI art. 293 B), the franchise ceilings are €101,000 for supplies of goods (tolerance €111,000) and €39,100 for service supplies (tolerance €43,100); the EU OSS distance-sales threshold is €10,000. A multi-family office whose discretionary portfolio-management fees qualify as exempt fund-management services (CGI art. 261-C-1-a) has no VAT registration duty; ancillary taxable advisory, corporate-administration and reporting fees are aggregated toward the €39,100 services threshold, and the option to tax under CGI art. 260-B may be exercised on qualifying exempt financial services.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: France does not operate real-time fiscal clearance, government digital stamping or an Italy-type SDI. The e-invoicing mandate (Ordonnance 2022-1470, as modified by Ordonnance 2024-893) requires domestic B2B e-invoicing and B2B/B2C e-reporting via the Portail Public de Facturation (PPF) or a certified Partenaire de Dématérialisation (PDP) using API connectivity: from 1 September 2026 for large and mid-size taxpayers, and from 1 September 2027 for all taxpayers including SARLs. Mandatory structured formats are Factur-X (hybrid PDF/A-3 plus XML), UBL 2.1, and CII (UN/CEFACT); the PPF API manages invoice routing, format acceptance, rejet and interoperability validation, but periodic VAT returns (CA3/3519) remain the fiscal-clearance event rather than transaction-level stamping.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: Goods exported outside the EU are zero-rated under CGI art. 262-I only where the exporter proves physical dispatch to the non-EU destination within 90 days of the supply (EU Reg. 282/2011 art. 43(2)); intra-community supplies are zero-rated under art. 262-II upon proof of the acquirer's valid EU VAT ID, the EC Sales List (DEB), and transport evidence. B2B services supplied to recipients established outside France are outside the scope of French VAT (CGI art. 259-1), invoiced without French VAT and subject to reverse charge at the customer's seat. For the multi-family office, discretionary portfolio management and investment advisory services rendered to non-French taxable private-client mandataries are either outside scope or exempt (art. 261-C-1-a) where they qualify as fund-management activities; service agreements, AML/KYC client files, fee invoices and mandate KPI reports must evidence the foreign establishment and economic substance of each delegation.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration: French DELTA / Déclaration en Douane (DAE) with MRN evidencing export from the EU customs territory, plus the DEB/Intrastat declaration where intra-union flows are involved
Transport proof: original Bill of Lading, Air Waybill or CMR consignment note, endorsed by the carrier, naming the French supplier as consignor and the non-EU buyer as consignee
Inward payment evidence: bank credit advice / SWIFT MT103 credit confirmation, or a bank attestation corroborating export proceeds, retained to substantiate the 180-day FX repatriation benchmark
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: DGFiP may reassess unsubstantiated zero-ratings within the general 3-year VAT limitation period (LPF art. L. 176), extended to 6 years for concealed or dissimulated operations and to 10 years for real-estate and certain listed-asset transactions. Failure to produce the statutory export bundle triggers output-VAT clawback with intérêt de retard (0.20% per month, CGI art. 1727), 5%/10% late-filing penalties (art. 1728 CGI), 40% for bad-faith underdeclaration (art. 1729 CGI) and 80% for manœuvres frauduleuses, in addition to criminal tax-fraud exposure (Code pénal art. 1741, up to €150,000 fine and 7 years' imprisonment), customs sanctions (Code des douanes art. 413 bis), and retrospective denial of refund credits; the general anti-abuse rule (LPF art. L. 64, CGI art. 205 A) may re-characterize artificial export or offshore-service structures.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Banque de France (Bank of France) acts as the national central bank and is the responsible statistical and credit-institution supervisory authority, while the European Central Bank (ECB) sets Eurozone monetary policy. Foreign-exchange administration and capital-movement screening fall under the Direction Générale du Trésor (DG Trésor) of the Ministry of Economy, Finance and Recovery. Banking prudential control and AML/CFT enforcement for credit institutions are carried out by the Autorité de Contrôle Prudentiel et de Résolution (ACPR), with the Autorité des Marchés Financiers (AMF) supervising investment services and discretionary portfolio-advisory activity.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: France meets the IMF Article VIII obligation, granting full current-account convertibility and unrestricted capital-account movement intra-EU under TFEU Articles 63 to 66. Profit remittance by an SARL to non-resident shareholders is freely permitted once the corporate income tax return (form 2065) is filed and the applicable withholding or distribution formalities under form 2561 are met; no specific foreign-exchange approval is required. The sole material restrictivity is the prior-authorization mechanism for foreign direct investment in sensitive sectors created by Decree No. 2019-1590 of 31 December 2019, which does not apply to the ISIC 6430 multi-family-office scope. Currency conversion from EUR to any OECD/EU currency is commercially unrestricted for the MFO's treasury function.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: No statutory surrender, mandatory conversion ratio, or repatriation timeline applies to French-domiciled receipts. Under Article L. 564-1 of the Code monétaire et financier, all cross-border settlements must be routed through an authorised credit institution or payment institution for monetary statistics and AML/CFT traceability. The MFO retains full discretion to maintain export or service proceeds in EUR or foreign currency. Reporting obligations are limited to the Banque de France's monthly balance-of-payments survey (form EME) only where cumulative cross-border payments exceed EUR 750,000 per calendar month, and to the FADET direct-investment declaration module for capital transactions, due within 20 business days of the transaction.

tier1_domestic_commercial_banks.bank_name: Société Générale SA (Private Banking and Securities Services)
Crédit Agricole Corporate and Investment Bank / LCL
BPCE Group / Natixis - Palatine Banque Privée

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Feasibility rating: LOW-MEDIUM. ACPR-licensed electronic-money institutions (for example Qonto or Lydia Solutions) and EU-passported EMIs may technically open a euro-denominated payment account and execute SEPA/SWIFT transfers, but an EMI cannot serve as a custody bank, settlement bank, or client-asset segregator for a discretionary portfolio-advisory MFO. Under Article L. 533-10 of the Code monétaire et financier, a regulated credit institution or an AMF-approved custodian must hold client assets. The EMI rail is therefore viable only as a secondary operating-expense conduit, never as the primary clearing or capital-escrow platform.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: French law and ACPR guidance permit video-identification and certain remote KYC procedures, but the high-risk MFO classification (automatically escalated under the bank's FATF-compliant risk model) makes an in-person interview with the gérant, the compliance officer and all ultimate beneficial owners effectively mandatory at the bank's corporate client branch in Paris or Lyon. A remote-only account opening without prior banking history is not feasible for this risk tier. The physical session also serves to certify the AMF registration of the MFO's portfolio-advisory activity (registration as a PSI or Conseil en Investissement Financier) and to validate signatory mandates under Article L. 223-18 of the French Commercial Code for SARL governance.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-risk sector designation: the multi-family-office function is treated by French banks under ACPR risk-management expectations as a high-risk business model due to complex ownership, inter-family asset pooling and non-face-to-face client instructions.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Provide (1) extrаit Kbis issued within 30 days; (2) Registre des bénéficiaires effectifs (UBO register) filed per Article L. 561-2-2 of the Code monétaire et financier; (3) AMF or CIF registration certificate; (4) two years of audited financial statements; (5) a written AML/CFT policy manual addressing client-category, transaction-monitoring, and sanctions screening; (6) a sworn declaration from the gérant on the source of funds and intended economic purpose; (7) board minutes authorising the account mandate with an operational signatory list.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Cross-border transfers originating from FATF grey-listed or EU-listed non-cooperative jurisdictions, often triggered by offshore trust or family-holding contributions into the French SARL.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Assemble a per-payment package containing (1) a source-of-wealth analysis for each contributing family; (2) an independent OFAC/EU/UN sanctions-screening certificate; (3) the underlying trust deed or family partnership agreement, apostilled and translated into French by a certified translator; (4) a French avocat's compliance opinion confirming no criminal-origin funds; (5) the complete SWIFT MT103 payment chain showing an EU/EAA intermediary correspondent bank; and (6) a copy of the sending institution's authorisation in its home state.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Non-resident shareholder chain and substance review: because the SARL permits non-resident ownership, the bank's KYC desk will challenge the French economic substance and the FATCA/CRS reporting classification of the entity.
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit a full substance file comprising (1) a French bail commercial or sub-lease with at least 24 months remaining; (2) French payroll records and URSSAF receipts for a minimum of two resident employees; (3) professional indemnity insurance with a French insurer; (4) the tax-residence certificate (certificat de résidence fiscale) issued by the DGFiP; (5) board resolutions proving that discretionary investment decisions are executed exclusively by French-resident signatories at the registered office; and (6) CRS portfolio data demonstrating that the French service activity is more than a bookkeeping vehicle.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Capital injections are credited through TARGET2 for EUR transfers or via SWIFT MT103/MT202 COV for multi-currency wires, with the remittance information referencing the shareholder board resolution and the statutory purpose of capital contribution. The French bank requires the operation to be flagged as a direct-investment inflow for Banque de France balance-of-payments statistics via the FADET electronic declaration (category 300/301 for company creation or capital increase), filed within 20 business days of receipt. Verification documents include the updated extrait Kbis, the UBO register, evidence of paid-up capital and a tax-clearance certificate (attestation de régularisation fiscale) for the SARL. Amounts above EUR 1,000,000 may trigger ACPR large-exposure due diligence and require 48-hours advance notice. No prior DG Trésor approval is required outside the sensitive-sector regime.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Outbound trade settlements are executed over SWIFT MT103 for direct payment obligations and MT202 COV for correspondent reimbursement. Documentary trade is supported by irrevocable commercial letters of credit issued under UCP 600 using the MT700 message sequence, with downstream confirmation through an EU correspondent. Sub-EUR-100,000 euro payments in the EEA clear via SEPA (SCT and SCT Inst); high-value euro payments use TARGET2 same-day RTGS. For custody-wire operations, disbursements follow the MT304 (account entry) or MT540/MT542 free-of-payment standards under standing instructions with the custodian. All disbursements must reference the underlying commercial invoice or discretionary mandate and must comply with AMF best-execution and anti-fraud controls; no DG Trésor pre-clearance applies.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: Outright FX forwards (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP, EUR/CHF) documented under an ISDA 2002 Master Agreement and a Credit Support Annex with a French or EU credit institution, subject to internal liquidity-risk limits

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) restricted to currencies without full convertibility (CNY, INR, IDR) with EUR cash settlement, carried as permitted OTC derivatives in accordance with ACPR/AMF eligibility rules
Cross-currency swaps (EUR/USD, EUR/GBP) with maturities exceeding 12 months, traded under ISDA/CSA collateralisation and assessed against EMIR clearing-threshold and risk-mitigation requirements
FX swaps (swap de change) of 1 week to 12 months tenor used solely for treasury liquidity rebalancing between the SARL and its custodian accounts

Short-dated OTC currency options (EUR call/USD put and reverse structures) with a maximum 12-month tenor and a concentration cap of EUR 50 million per open position, classified as plain-vanilla instruments under CRR Simple, Transparent and Comparable (STC) criteria

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual financial statements (comptes annuels: balance sheet, income statement, notes) and filing with the RCS
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Greffe du Tribunal de Commerce / Registre du Commerce et des Sociétés (Infogreffe)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Shareholder approval within 6 months of fiscal year-end; deposit with the registry within 1 month of approval, i.e., no later than 7 months after closing.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Failure to file may result in judicial injunction with astreinte, loss of legal exemptions, and ultimately administrative strike-off (radiation) from the RCS; prolonged non-compliance may be referred to the Public Prosecutor.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual corporate income tax return (déclaration de résultats n°2065-SD) and supporting liasse fiscale (n°2050-SD)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Direction Générale des Finances Publiques (DGFiP) via EDI/EFI e-filing
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: For fiscal years closing 31 December, generally by the date corresponding to the second business day after 1 May (typically 3 May); for non-calendar fiscal years, within the statutory period based on the closing date.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Late filing and payment trigger a 10%-80% late-filing penalty under CGI Art. 1728, 0.40% monthly late-payment interest under CGI Art. 1727, and possible tax enforcement measures against the company.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: An independent statutory auditor (commissaire aux comptes) is mandatory when, at fiscal year-end, the SARL exceeds two of three thresholds: total balance sheet €4.0 million, net revenue €8.0 million, and 50 average employees (French Commercial Code Art. L123-16 and D123-200); additionally, a multi-family office holding a discretionary portfolio management or special financial license is subject to periodic statutory audit requirements of the AMF/ACPR regardless of size.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: French GAAP (Plan Comptable Général, PCG) is required for legal entity statutory accounts; EU-IFRS is optional for consolidated accounts; prudential and AML/LCB-FT reporting must follow ACPR/AMF instructions.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: France does not impose a free-standing annual UBO re-filing for every SARL; however, the SARL must declare beneficial owners in the Registre des Bénéficiaires Effectifs upon registration and within 30 days of any change in ownership. For this regulated multi-family office activity, the annual audit and shareholders' meeting must include a documented annual re-verification of beneficial ownership as part of the AML/KYC and high-risk client review process; the result is recorded in the minutes and in internal statutory registers.
mandatory_on_site_statutory_registers: Register of Members and Share Transfers (registre des mouvements de titres)
Register of Directors and Manager Decisions (registre des décisions et délibérations des dirigeants)
Minute Book of Shareholders' Meetings (registre des procès-verbaux d'assemblées)

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 600-1,800 per year for professional domiciliation or registered-office services, with premium commercial locations in Paris and lower ranges in regional centers.
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: USD 6,000-18,000 per year for a certified statutory audit of a financial-services SARL, depending on asset volume, number of client families, and regulatory reporting complexity.

stage_6.effective_tax_rate_incentives: Statutory tax holidays or preferential deductions
